items.source: Auto-configuration for exporting traces with OTLP. Brave does not support OTLP, so we only configure it for OpenTelemetry. OTLP defines three transports that are supported: gRPC (/protobuf), HTTP/protobuf, HTTP/JSON. From these transports HTTP/JSON is not supported by the OTel Java SDK, and it seems there are no plans supporting it in the future, see: opentelemetry-java#3651. Because this class configures components from the OTel SDK, it can't support HTTP/JSON. By default, we auto-configure HTTP/protobuf. If you want to use gRPC, you need to set management.opentelemetry.tracing.export.otlp.transport=grpc. If you define a OtlpHttpSpanExporter or OtlpGrpcSpanExporter, this auto-configuration will back off.
items.translation: Auto-configuration 用于使用 OTLP 导出跟踪。Brave 不支持 OTLP，因此我们仅针对 OpenTelemetry 进行配置。OTLP 定义了三种支持的传输方式：gRPC (/protobuf)、HTTP/protobuf 和 HTTP/JSON。在这些传输方式中，HTTP/JSON 不受 OTel Java SDK 支持，且似乎未来也没有支持它的计划，参见：opentelemetry-java#3651。由于该类配置了来自 OTel SDK 的组件，因此无法支持 HTTP/JSON。默认情况下，我们自动配置 HTTP/protobuf。如果您想使用 gRPC，需要设置management.opentelemetry.tracing.export.otlp.transport=grpc。如果您定义了OtlpHttpSpanExporter或OtlpGrpcSpanExporter，此自动配置将回退。
